facts.fact: Masaar says the Alexandria Economic Court ruled in February 2025 that Orange Egypt pay EGP 10 million in compensation for replacing a customer's SIM card without consent, citing Article 4 of Law No. 151 of 2020 on controller obligations.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: Masaar says the executive regulations of the Personal Data Protection Law had not been issued, leaving most of its provisions inoperable (date is the document's published date).
